name: Don't Make Me Tap The Sign
look: Two stacked stills from The Simpsons. Top: a stern bus driver in a blue uniform and cap grips the big steering wheel, captioned "DON'T MAKE ME TAP THE SIGN." Bottom: a yellow finger taps a blank white sign posted beside him.
text: DON'T MAKE ME TAP THE SIGN.
use: Used when someone keeps breaking or ignoring a rule that has been stated many times. The blank sign holds that rule or obvious fact, and the driver's line warns that he is tired of repeating it.
slots: the blank sign: the rule or obvious fact
examples: We are not there yet. Stop asking.
The leftovers in the blue container are not for you
